_doc: Forge graded-verify rubric for RAG/answer-quality tasks (scout #7, 2026-07-13). Owner-editable. Used by the forge-graded-verify skill: review-boss scores each criterion 1-4 with evidence + feedback. Advisory only — never gates irreversible actions. ADAPT per project; do not drop-in blindly.

criteria.descriptor: 1=claims unsupported/invented; 2=some claims traceable to sources; 3=most claims cite the right source; 4=every non-trivial claim grounded in a cited source with correct attribution
criteria.raise: add explicit citations to the retrieved passages for each factual claim; drop or flag anything not in the sources

criteria.descriptor: 1=logic broken/contradictory; 2=mostly follows but gaps; 3=sound with minor leaps; 4=each step follows and is justified
criteria.raise: make the reasoning steps explicit and check each conclusion against the cited evidence

criteria.descriptor: 1=ignores most of the question; 2=answers part; 3=answers the core; 4=fully addresses every part of the question
criteria.raise: enumerate the sub-questions and confirm each is answered

criteria.descriptor: 1=wrong; 2=partly right; 3=right on the main point; 4=fully correct incl. edge cases
criteria.raise: verify the answer against the sources and re-check any figures/dates/names

criteria.descriptor: 1=hallucinates when unsure; 2=hedges vaguely; 3=flags uncertainty; 4=clearly says what it cannot answer from the sources and offers a safe next step
criteria.raise: when the sources do not support an answer, say so explicitly instead of guessing
